Our Approach

Estate-Grade Care for Properties That Demand It

The Hills District operates at a different scale. Blocks in Kenthurst, Middle Dural, and Glenhaven are often several acres — with extensive hedging, large screening plantings, and grounds maintenance requirements that smaller operations simply can't handle.

We work with the right equipment for large-scale hedging: professional long-reach STIHL trimmers that handle tall screening hedges safely and efficiently. We have the capacity for long-running jobs, and we maintain a reliable schedule that keeps the property in ongoing order.

For acreage properties, a care plan is usually the right answer — a scheduled programme of visits that covers hedging, mowing, mulching, and maintenance on a regular basis, so the grounds are always well-maintained.
